The binary on disk is corrupted/truncated — a leftover, torn artifact from an earlier interrupted build that Cargo's fingerprint cache never invalidated. The `target/debug/incremental/` dir had ~10+ stale hash variants for the `sea_forge` crate alone, consistent with cache churn on this filesystem.

Confirming: cleaning and rebuilding just this crate should fix it without touching source.

content.text:
`devbox run -- just test` exits 0, full suite green, no code changes needed.

**Root cause**: `target/debug/deps/sea_forge-8fa4cf68b27e02a8` was a corrupted binary on disk — `readelf -d` showed an empty dynamic section (just a NULL terminator) despite the ELF header claiming `dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2`; `ldd` failed on it too. Cargo's fingerprint cache considered it up-to-date and kept reusing it, so it segfaulted inside `ld-linux-x86-64.so.2` (null-deref during TLS/relocation setup) before any test even ran. The `target/debug/incremental/` dir had ~10+ stale hash variants for this one crate, consistent with cache churn/torn writes on this filesystem.

Fix: `cargo clean -p sea-forge-cli` (removed 18 GiB of stale incremental artifacts), then rebuild — clean binary, tests pass.

If this recurs, `cargo clean -p sea-forge-cli` (or a full `cargo clean` if it spreads to other crates) is the move — not a source fix.

content.text:
Diagnosed it — two separate things got mixed into your `git status`, only one is an actual gitignore gap:

**1. Real gitignore gap:** `.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.opencode/`, `.entire/` are local agent-tool config/state dirs (Claude Code settings, Codex config, OpenCode plugins, and the "entire" session-continuity tool that hooked into `.githooks/commit-msg`/`post-rewrite`). Same category as the `.omc/` entry you already ignore — just missing from the list.

**2. Not a gitignore issue — my fault:** The `sea-forge-integrity-*` / `sea-forge-m15-t15-*` dirs at repo root are leaked test artifacts. `crates/sea-forge-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs` builds temp dirs via `std::env::temp_dir()`, which should resolve to `/tmp`. When I ran the test suite through the sandboxed `ctx_execute` tool, `TMPDIR` resolved to your repo root instead, so the tests dropped their scratch directories directly into your working tree instead of `/tmp`. They're disposable test junk, not something to gitignore-and-keep — I'll delete them.

`.githooks/commit-msg` and `.githooks/post-rewrite` are real hook files the "entire" tool installed (mirroring your already-tracked `post-commit`/`pre-push`) — that's a decide-to-`git add`-or-not call for you, not a gitignore bug, so I'm leaving those alone.
